mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_VALIANT_* from Data/Player/CW_BootMale04.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:236-243; no helm). MU's number 37. Ours is *Male38 by the index-plus-one rule.
why_this_one: Season 2's lower-level sets, missing here (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's): the Magic Gladiator's.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (Season 2's sets; 0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.class_level_note: The Magic Gladiator's: OpenMU's magicGladiatorClassLevel 1, his only class. No helm: his sets go bare-headed (MuMain loads no CW_HelmMale 4).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player flamset_*.OZJ, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: red plate edged in silver; flamset_head the collar and hood on the armour.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain, the shading painted on.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_VALIANT_* (no glow, no chrome pass). Its full-set bonus is not given: sim::setDefense counts only Storm Crow and Hurricane for the Magic Gladiator.
